query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

content.text:
*steps up onto the bow of the ship, coat billowing in the salty sea wind, and addresses the crew with a booming voice*

---

"Gather 'round, ye brave souls of the sea! Lend me yer ears and steel yer hearts, for today we sail toward **destiny itself!**

Out there, beyond the horizon, lies a treasure beyond imagination — gold enough to fill every pocket, jewel enough to blind the sun itself! Kings and queens have searched for it and **failed.** But we? We are no ordinary crew. We are the finest, boldest, most fearless souls to ever dare challenge these waters!

Every storm we've weathered, every battle we've won, every starless night we've navigated — it has ALL led us to **this moment.** The sea has tested us, and we have never broken. Not once!

Now I ask ye — are ye sailors, or are ye **legends?!** Because legends don't turn back when the wind howls! Legends don't drop anchor when the map gets blurry! Legends **push forward** — through the fog, through the waves, through whatever Davy Jones dares throw at us!

That treasure isn't just gold and silver, me hearties. It's **freedom.** It's the life we've always dreamed of — no masters, no chains, no empty bellies. Just open skies, full sails, and the sweet taste of **victory.**

So tighten those ropes, trust your compass, trust your captain, and above all — **trust each other.** We sail AS ONE, and we shall triumph AS ONE!

Now — **WHO'S WITH ME?!** 🏴‍☠️⚓"

---

*The crew erupts in thunderous cheers as the ship charges forward into the vast, glittering sea.*
